messages:
Alex Kim: Anyone up for a pickup basketball game in the courtyard at 5pm? Keep it casual — no tryouts, just fun.
Priya Patel: I'm in if I can duck out by 5:45, have a demo prep at 6 😂
Marcus Li: I'll bring a spare ball and some cones.
Samira Khan: Can someone spot me for layups? Still working on my left hand.
Daniel Park: Count me in, may be +5 late (zoom).
Alex Kim: Cool. @Office Ops Bot can you check if the courtyard is free?
Office Ops Bot: Courtyard schedule shows available 5:00-6:00pm — reservation not required.
Priya Patel: Sweet. Quick note: please no cleats on the courts (we had a scuff incident last month).
Marcus Li: Got it. Also who wants to be on Team Blue? :basketball:
Samira Khan: Team Blue!
Alex Kim: Team Red then.
Daniel Park: Whoever can actually hit a shot 😅
Alex Kim: See y'all at 5 — bring water and good vibes.
Priya Patel: I'll bring a small first-aid kit.
Marcus Li: And a towel.
Samira Khan: Yay sport stuff :)
